description: At Saturday’s Kansas State Fair gubernatorial debate, William Hendrix, the disgraced former vice chair of the Kansas Young Republicans, spent the debate in the second row of the audience, leading chants for Ty Masterson and interacting with members of Masterson’s campaign team.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Cindy Holscher for Kansas
title: Holscher Slams Ty Masterson for Campaigning with Disgraced Kobach Staffer at the State Fair | Cindy Holscher for Governor
